fusions.name: Out of Nowhere
fusions.desc: A sudden cut that deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.4 times their remaining damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Quick Nick
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Honed in the Dark
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawn Red
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your damage heals you for 15% of what it deals for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
